title: Quarantine failed merge-repair blockers before downstream work starts
description: Turn failed merge-repair and blocked-conflict tasks into explicit quarantine owners. Downstream overlapping PRDs must wait until the owner is retried, manually resolved, stopped, demoted, or proven integrated.

userStories.title: Keep failed merge-repair owners blocking overlap
userStories.description: A failed task with merge-repair context or blocked-conflict integration state must continue to own its hot surface.
acceptanceCriteria: Later overlapping tasks are not started behind a failed merge-repair owner.
The queue attention reason distinguishes quarantine from generic failure.
A non-overlapping task can still start while the quarantine exists.

userStories.title: Provide bounded exits from quarantine
userStories.description: Retry, stop, demote, or exact integration proof should be explicit ways out of quarantine.
acceptanceCriteria: Retry preserves anchored merge repair context when the conflict is still present.
Exact mergeability or already-integrated proof clears quarantine without redoing unrelated stories.
Stop or explicit demotion releases or transfers ownership with an auditable queue reason.

userStories.title: Test repeated no-progress and progress cases
userStories.description: Avoid fixed attempt loops that stop despite objective progress, while still stopping true repeated failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated identical failed merge-repair observations stop according to policy.
Shrinking conflicts or changed proof signatures refresh recovery state.
npm test passes with quarantine and retry regressions.
